composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-111, "+24V DC DISTRIBUTION") is the DC breaker schedule for THREE distinct panels: AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS, FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS, and the EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY/EMERGENCY PANEL/GMDSS trio, plus a 24V service-supply fuse/switch group. Each named load row is a distinct piece of equipment fed from its own breaker on one of these panels; the panels themselves (and the 24V service supply bus, and the emergency battery feed) are the infrastructure that all equipment/functions attach through. Established engineer mappings are used verbatim for node attachment.
